questions.prompt: According to the sample playbook, what is the maximum discount a rep can approve on their own for annual prepay?
questions.explanation: The playbook states reps may discount up to 10% on their own for annual prepay; anything above that needs manager or finance approval.

questions.prompt: Per the sample playbook, what should a rep do as soon as a buyer mentions procurement or InfoSec?
options: Wait until the buyer asks for it directly
Send the security questionnaire pack and loop in the solutions engineer
Offer a discount to speed things up
Escalate to the VP of Sales
questions.answer: Send the security questionnaire pack and loop in the solutions engineer
questions.explanation: The playbook says to send the security questionnaire pack immediately and involve the solutions engineer early, since reviews stall when they start late.
